title: The Fast Trick to Multiply by 99
description: Multiplying by 100 and subtracting the original number instead of multiplying by 99 directly.
narration_lines: Here's a fast way to multiply by 99. What's 47 times 99?
Multiply by 100 instead -- just add two zeros.

params.footnote: multiplying by 99 is always ×100 then subtract once
